# bichos

> Bio-Mimetic Framework for Agentic Software Quality Assurance. Swarm intelligence for autonomous codebase analysis, inspired by eusocial insect colonies.

## Authorship

All code in this repository was generated by a large language model. Human contribution: requirements, design decisions, planning, and review.
